tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i cho ga la brten nas brtan bzhugs 'bul tshul dbang bcu grub pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs padmor// gus pas btud nas dam pa'i skyes bu la// brtan bzhugs 'bul tshul dbang bcu'i ye shes mchog /grub pa'i dga' ston bdud rtsi'i mchod yon spro// 'di la bzhi/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi cho ga 'phros don gzhan bshad pa'o// dang po la/ mdun bskyed zhabs brtan yo byad gnyis// zhes pa ltar las dang po ni/ dus tshes gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po 'dzoms pa'i snga char bla ma'i bzhugs khri'i g.yas phyogs su stegs bu khebs ldan gyi khar kho bos byas pa'i cho ga 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho las 'byung ba ltar maṇḍal dang mchod gtor sogs legs par bsham/ de'ang tshom bu'i mal du sgrol ma dkar mo'i sku brnyan mngon rtogs dang mthun pa bzhugs su gsol na shin tu legs/ gzhan yang slob dpon gyi mdun rdor dril 'thor nas/ sgrub grogs rnams kyi mdun du rol mo'i bye brag sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'du bya/ gnyis pa ni/ bla ma'i mdun phyogs lta bu go skabs yangs par stegs bu ras bzang pos bkab par me tog sil ma dgram/ de'i steng du zhabs brtan gyi mchod pa nyer spyod spyi dang*/ spos/ mar me/ zhal zas sogs kyi phreng ba gtsang zhing bkod pas mdzes pa/ maṇḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa/ sgrol dkar gyi sku bris 'bur gang rung lta bu'i sku rten na bza' dang bcas pa/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i mdo sogs gsung rten glegs bam sgril tshas dang bcas pa/ thugs rten rnam rgyal mchod rten lta bu cod pan dang bcas pa/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs bkod legs su bstar/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ rang gi bya ba dang*/

mchog gi yul la bya ba'o// dang po ni/ rang nyid sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa stan bde ba la 'khod de/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung gtor ma cha gsum gyi bar 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ kho bos byas pa'i sgrub mchod kyi cho ga 'chi med rol mtsho ltar nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa la/ bla ma lhar 1 bskyed sngags bzlas 2 mchod/3 /gsol gdab 4 byin rlabs 5 brda mtshon 6 dbul// brtan bzhugs gsol 7 bzhes 7 gtang rag dbul/9 /rgyal tshab mnga' 10 gsol shis pa 11 brjod// ces pa ltar bcu gcig las/ dang po ni/ zhabs brtan 'bul yul gyi bzhugs khri'i steng du/ stan dkar rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa bting ba'i khar/ bla ma de nyid spos rol gyis mtshon pa'i bkur sti dang bcas spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de nas rang dang sgrub pa'i grogs rnams gral la 'khod de/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ zhes rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags dang*/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba'i rgyas bgegs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri gzhom gzhig dang bral ba sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbus su/ pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo tām̐ yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje slob dpon chen po'am/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing nor bu chu shel dri ma med pa ltar dwangs shing 'od 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/

g.yon pas utpa la dkar po'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyis thad kar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mtshon pa'i brdar rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum du gyes pa'i dbus kyi me tog kha bye ba/ g.yas 'bras bu/ g.yon gong bu'i rnam par yod pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud ltag par bcings shing lan bu ring du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag zhabs kyi mthil rnams la spyan re re ste ye shes kyi spyan bdun mnga' ba/ zla ba'i rgyab yol dang 'od kor can/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ oṃ gu ru āryā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ shabda'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tuttā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ gnyis pa ni/ bla ma rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud lnga dang ldan pa'i lte bar tām̐ yig dkar po/

de'i mtha' skor du/ ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru zhes pas bskor ba/ de'i mdun du oṃ/ rgyab tu hā/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du tā re tuttā re tu re swā/ zhes pa'i yig 'bru re yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud nang ma la/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ zhes pa g.yon skor du yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ zhes pa g.yas skor du yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya wa da ta/ teṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ zhes pa g.yas skor du yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la rdo rje sngon mo'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng ba g.yas skor du yod pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ bar chad dang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems dang bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs dang 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te thugs ka'i 'khor lo dang yig 'bru rnams la thim pas/ sku tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes la sogs pa rgyas par byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tutta re tu re ā yur puṇya dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs ci nus dang*/ ā li kā li ye dharmā rnams lan gsum res brtan cing nus ldan du bya'o// gsum pa ni/ mchod pa 'bul ba'i thog mar las kyi rdo rjes tshogs pa thams cad la me tog bkye/ zhabs brtan gyi mchod pa la dmigs te yakṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda'i bar sbyar bas byin gyis brlab/ dharmā ra ṇi ta rol mo dang bcas pa lan gsum gyis byin phab ste gzhag tshogs pa'i gtso bo zhig gis langs te maṇḍal tshom bu sum cu so bdun bkod pa lag g.yon du thogs nas g.yas pas spos reng thogs te brda sprod pa'i tshul dang bcas te/ thams cad kyis dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bskal brgyar brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba'i ched du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu zhes bskul nas/ thams cad kyis oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa zhes sogs nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bskal brgyar brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba'i ched du dbul bar bgyi'o zhes bsgyur nas/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir zhes pa man chad 'dra bar byas la/ spro na gang gi mchod rdzas sogs dang*/ deng nas byang chub nas/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol gyi bar brjod/ mchod pa 'bul ba so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sku tshe brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ gu ru āryā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas shabda'i bar 'don pa bsgyur te dharmā ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ spro na rgyal srid bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lnga 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad spyi ltar la/ bzhes shig sku tshe brtan par bzhugs su gsol// zhes pa'i tshig dang mtshan sngags bsgyur te 'bul bas mtshon mchod phreng rgyas par bstar kyang legs mod/ sku yul gnyan pa sogs la yun 'gor dogs na dkyus ma 'di tsam gyis 'thus shing legs pa'ang yin la/

bstod pa'i mchod pa ni rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tuttā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa tsam mam spro na tshigs bcad lhag ma rnams kyis kyang bstod/ bzhi pa ni/ bla ma rje btsun ma'i spyi bo'i rigs bdag 'od dpag med yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtha' skor kun tu rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bstan srung nor lha'i tshogs rnams mngon sum du byon pa la/ thugs rgyud bskul ba'i gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis bla ma'i sku tshe brtan cing phrin las rgyas par byin gyis brlabs/ bstan srung nor lha rnams kyis bar chad kyi bgegs bsal bar bsams la/ thal mo sbyar te gdangs dang bcas pas/ thub pa'i dbang po rje btsun sgrol ma dang*// ngag dbang grags pa rdo rje gdan pa'i zhabs// ba ri lo tsā grub chen gle nag pa// bshes gnyen sbre ba rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// mnyam med sgam po pa dang sgam tshul rje// shes rab byang chub dwags po 'dul 'dzin zhabs// 'bri gung gling pa dam chos gling pa rje// chos kyi tshul khrims rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal ba brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// lha lung thog gnas pa dang chos kyi dbang*// byang chub bzang po bkra shis rnam par rgyal// bsod nams lha dbang dpal ldan rgyal mtshan dang*// phyogs las rnam rgyal rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// tshar chen mkhyen brtse bslab gsum dbang rab zhabs// bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog grub dang*// mkhyen rab byams pa rmor chen gnas gsar ba// kun dga' blo gros rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// mkhas grub dbang po kun dga' bstan 'dzin sogs// 'chi med mchog stsol rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas// bstan srung nor lha rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// zhes mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pas/

bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rigs bdag tshe dpag tu med pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig dang*/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung nor lha mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bum nang du song bas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur/ de nyid gyen du 'phyur zhing kha nas lud pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ bar du gcod pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sbyangs/ 'chi med sku tshe'i dngos grub thob/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar gyi rgyun dang 'od zer dkar po sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sku lus kyi spyi gtsug nas zhabs mthil gyi bar thams cad mer gyis khengs pas sku tshe'i bar du gcod pa thams cad byang zhing dag tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes la sogs pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang bdud rtsi'i zil pas phrom mer gtams shing mtshan dpe'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs spyod rgyun gyis rtag pa'i go 'phang la dbang bsgyur bar gyur ces brjod cing bsams la sngags ci rigs pa bzla/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bla ma'i sku'i phyi rol du zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad sbubs can zhwa theb kha sbyar ba lta bu sra zhing brtan pa'i phyi rol nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur

bar 'dir 'od zer drug sbrags kyi dmigs rim tshang ma sbyor ba'i tshul yang snang ba tshig cung zad bsgyur te gsal btab kyang 'gal ba med mod/ dkyus la 'di tsam gyis chog go/ par bsams la ā li kā li ye dharmā rnams bzlas shing rol mo dang bcas me tog 'thor zhing brtan par bya/ drug pa ni/ bla ma'i phyag tu sgrol dkar gyi snang brnyan lta bu'i sku rten phul la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs/ bdag sogs gdul bya rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'pho 'gyur med par dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba'i brdar sku'i rten dbul bar bgyi'o// gsung rten tshe mdo'am glegs bam gang rung 'bul zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs/ bdag sogs gdul bya rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du gsung mi zad brgyan gyi 'khor los dus rtag tu zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad par bskor bar gsol ba'i brdar gsung gi rten dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rten rnam rgyal mchod rten nam pad spungs sam rdor dril lta bu 'bul zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs/ bdag sogs gdul bya rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo bden gnyis zung 'jug gi ting 'dzin zab mo las ma g.yos par dmigs pa med pa'i snying rjes bstan 'gro thams cad mi 'dor bar gsol ba'i brdar thugs kyi rten dbul bar bgyi'o// yon tan gyi rten du rnam rgyal bum pa 'bul zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag

'gro ba'i mgon skyabs/ bdag sogs gdul bya rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan yid bzhin gyi nor bus sems can gyi re ba ma lus pa bskang bar gsol ba'i brdar yon tan gyi rten dbul bar bgyi'o// phrin las kyi rten du rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan 'bul zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs/ bdag sogs gdul bya rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du mdzad pa phrin las kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad par gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang dbang po dang bsam pa bzhin du 'jug par gsol ba'i brdar phrin las kyi rten dbul bar bgyi'o zhes dang*/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar zhing gus pas btud de/ bla ma rang gi zhabs brtan nam/ spyi 'gro'i brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad gang 'os kyis lan gsum sogs su gsol ba rtse gcig tu gdab cing me tog 'thor/ zhabs brtan gyi 'bul tshan sogs yod na skabs 'dir dbul/ bdun pa ni/ bla ma'i sku che ba'i yon tan dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga sogs las brtsams pa'i brjod bya zab cing don che ba/ rjod byed snyan zhing go sla ba/ brjod tshul bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan can gyi smra ba'i rgyan dang ldan pa gdul bya thams cad yid 'khul nus pa'i zhal bzhes zhu ba'i snyan 'bul mdo rgyas 'tshams pa zhig tshogs pa'i gtso bor gyur pas gus pa chen po'i phyag gsum byas nas thal mo sbyar ba dang bcas blo gros kyi bang mdzod kha phye ste skabs su bab pa'i legs bshad kyi mchod sprin spro bar bya ba yin la/ spyir btang du spros pa mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis gsol na/ slar yang 'dren mchog bstan pa'i snang byed chen po'i zhabs la gus pa chen po'i phyag btsal te rtse gcig tu gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying po ni/ ji skad du/ mgon po zhi ba lhas/

'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu// bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang*// bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'gro ba rnams kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde ma lus pa ni kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che kho na la rag las shing*/ lung rtogs kyis bsdus pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'ang bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas gces par 'dzin pa la rag las pa'i tshul mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyi zhal snga nas/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te// lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do// de 'dzin byed pa'ang smra byed dang*// sgrub par byed pa kho na yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de dag thams cad kyi gtso bo ni bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams zhabs pad brtan cing phrin las rgyas pa 'ba' zhig la rag las pa yin te/ rgyal bas lung bstan brnyes pa'i skyes bu dam pa ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung las/ tshad med mkhyen dang brtse ba'i dpal mnga' zhing*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa srog ltar gces 'dzin pa'i// mtshungs med bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams// sku tshe ring zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsungs pas na bstan pa yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba gdab dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang don dam par mgon po byams pas/ 'phags pas skye dang 'chi ba dang*// rga ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs// zhes gsungs pa ltar skye 'chi la mnga' brnyes pas gsol ba gdab min la ma ltos mod/ 'on kyang gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams kyi snang ngor mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul ston pa'ang yod de/ gser 'od dam pa las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan yongs mi 'da'// chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te// sems can rnams ni smin bya'i phyir// mya ngan 'das pa'ang ston par mdzad// ces gsungs pas na gsol ba gdab par bya dgos te/

phal po che'i mdo las kyang*/ mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi// zhes gsungs shing*/ ji ltar gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshul yang*/ bdag cag 'dir 'dus shing tshogs pa rnams kyis 'chi med sku tshe'i cho ga dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bzang po'i mchod sprin gyis mdun bdar/ mos gus gdung shugs drag pos lhar bcas bstan 'gro yongs kyi skyabs dang*/ mgon dang*/ dpung gnyen gcig pur gyur pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gang nyid/ spyir kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yun ring du rgyas pa'i phyir dang*/ lhag par bdag sogs gdul bya rnams kyi dpal mgon dam pa nyid du sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnam pa gsum nam yang mi 'gyur bar nges pa lnga ldan gyi mgon po bzhin du/ 'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston par dngos po kun gyis btud de gsol ba lan brgya stong du mar rtse gcig tu 'debs pa lags na dmigs pa med pa'i brtse ba dang*/ ye shes gzigs pa dam pas rjes su dgongs te de de bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes par ci gnang*// zhes zhu'o// spyir zhal bzhes zhu ba'i bshad pa 'di tsam du ma zad/ khri ston lta bu'i gal che ba'i tshe spro zhing nus na gong gi maṇḍal 'bul ba'i thog mar yang maṇḍal gyi rnam bshad rgyas par spros te brda sprad pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis mjug bkra shis kyi skabs kyang bshad pa ci rigs pa mdzad pa'i srol ltar byung na shin tu legs so// brgyad pa ni/ bla ma de nyid nas kyang*/ gal te bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// sems can phan pa'i rgyur 'gyur na// mi lo brgya rtsa brgyad lhag sogs// gang 'dod 'tsho bar bla ma dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bdag

/dbang bcu ldan par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa lta bu'i zhal bzhes gnang byung ba dang*/ dgu pa ni/ maṇḍal rgya che ba thogs te/ thams cad kyis gtang rag gi maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badzra bhū mi nas tshom bu so bdun ma 'bul ba'i gsham du/ 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bskal brgyar zhabs kyi padmo brtan par bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir zhes sogs brjod do// bcu pa ni/ de dag brtan par bya ba'i phyir mdun bskyed rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs rnams lhan cig pas sku tshe la sogs pa la dbang 'byor pa thob pa'i phyir rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba dang*/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'bul ba'i bkra shis kyi cho gas phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa gtad par gyur/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ zhes rtsa ba'i rig pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ re re bzhin du thogs nas 'bul ba'i tshul dang bcas te/ lha rdzas las grub lte ba shin tu zlum// rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang*// sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur pa'i// 'khor lo rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ tsakra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas bai ḍūrya// kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing*// dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan de bzhin// nor bu rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ gzugs mdzes blta na sdug cing tshul bzang ma// pags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan// yid 'ong 'dod rgu'i reg bya dang ldan pa'i// btsun mo rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ wa sti ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ gang yang rgyal la mu tig mdangs ldan pa'i// gser sogs mang po thugs la phul ba ltar// bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan pa'i// blon po rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ha tā ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/

yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni// rab gnas gangs can ri 'dra glang po che// rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i// glang po rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ hasti ratna a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i// sa rnams bskor te slar yang ldog nus pa'i// rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar yid 'ong ba'i// rta mchog rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ a shwa ratna a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ong 'gyur ba'i// ma lus bdud dpung 'jigs par byed pa ste// dpa' brtan 'byor pa'i dpung dang bcas pa yi// dmag mi rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ khaḍga ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes dbul/ bcu gcig pa ni/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi gzugs bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mam̐ las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe dang*/ phrin las dang*/ dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ maṅga la aṣṭa dra bya āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ gzugs re re bzhin du thogs nas 'bul ba'i tshul dang bcas te/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'ang me long gi rdzas la brten nas sku tshe dang phrin las mtha' yas pa la dbang 'byor zhing shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi// ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te// rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i// bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /de bzhin du sbyar la/ glang po che sa srung gis gi waṃ phyag tu= gi waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman// sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas// nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig

/zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag tu= zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste// snying po rnam dag ye shes rnam rtogs nas// yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi gyur cig /rtsā 'tshong bkra shis kyis rtswa dūrba phyag tu= dūrbas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab grub nas// nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel gyur cig /lha tshangs pas shing tog bilba phyag tu= bilba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun// byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang don kun grub gyur cig /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil pa phyag tu= dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te// chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /bram ze skar rgyal gyi bus li khri phyag tu= li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te// chos rnams ma nor dbang du bsdus nas kyang*// chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs kar phyag tu= yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste// mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi byed shog /ces dbul zhing*/ phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa'i mdo rgyud las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod mthar rol mo'i sgra snyan par sbyar/ me tog gi char sil mar bsnyil bas dge legs su byas te bla ma rang gnas su spyan drangs/ gsum pa rjes ni/

mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa zhal bsos la bsang sbyang byin rlabs nas bkra shis kyi rang cho ga'i dkyus ltar la mdun bskyed sku rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya ba tsam khyad par ro// bzhi pa 'phros don cung zad bshad na/ de lta bu'i tshul 'di ni tshar lugs sgrol dkar 'od zer drug sbrags kyi cho ga dang sbyar ba yin la/ gzhan du ngor lugs rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i cho ga mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i zur 'debs bcas kyi steng nas gtong bar mos na/ sbyor ba bsham bkod sogs dmigs bsal rnams yig cha de dag gi gzhung sor bzhag la/ spyir btang zhabs brtan gyi yo byad sogs gong ltar/ dngos gzhi mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed nas bzung mdun bskyed bzlas pa gsol gdab yan chad gzhung ltar nyams su blang*/ brtan bzhugs dngos kyi skabs gzhan gong dang 'dra ba la/ bzlas pa'i skabs/ bla ma rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo'i lte bar/ oṃ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes rgyas par mdzod cig hā zhes dang*/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis tā re tuttā re tu re swa zhes pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros sogs gong ltar/ dbyangs gsal rten snying bzla ba rnams mi dgos/ gsol 'debs skabs/ mdun bskyed kyi steng gi nam mkha' dang bar mtshams mtha' skor kun tu rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bstan srung nor lha'i tshogs rnams mngon sum du byon pa la thugs rgyud bskul ba'i gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis bla ma'i sku tshe brtan cing phrin las rgyas par byin gyis brlabs/ bstan srung nor lha rnams kyis bar chad kyi bgegs bsal bar bsams la/ thal mo sbyar te gdangs dang bcas pas/ stobs bcu'i dbang phyug ston pa shākya'i tog /rje btsun sgrol ma paṇa chen shākya shrī// mkhan chen byang chub dpal dang bde ba dpal// grags pa gzhon nu rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// bsod nams grags pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs// dpal ldan tshul khrims shar chen ye shes mtshan// ngor chen kun dga' bzang po mus chen rje// paṇa chen chos dpal rnams ni=

/blo gros rgya mtsho rin chen bzang po dang*// sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams dkon mchog legs// dpal ldan don grub dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// sangs rgyas phun tshogs rnams ni= /bstan 'dzin lhun grub nam mkha' bsam grub dang*// kun dga' blo gros nam mkha' 'chi med zhabs// tshe dang ye shes dngos grub mchog brnyes pa// kun dga' bstan 'dzin rnams ni= /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// bka' srol byin rlabs dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas// bstan srung nor lha rnams ni sogs sbyar/ byin rlabs skabs/ mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma dang nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs thams cad 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub zla ba zhu ba'i khu ba lta bu dpag tu med pa byon te/ bla ma rje btsun mar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas bzhugs te/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim/ de rnams las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar gyi rgyun dang 'od zer dkar po sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i sogs gong ltar sbyar bas grub bo// yang tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs la sbyar ba'i tshe/ tshar chen rin po che'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga lta bu la mtshon na/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi bsham dang*/ dngos gzhi sgrub mchod rnams de'i gzhung ltar/ zhabs brtan dngos kyi tshe slob dpon tshe dpag med du bskyed/ bdag bskyed la tshig kha bsgyur ba dang bcas thugs kar sngags phreng bkod nas spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bcas bzlas pa bya/ gsol 'debs skabs/ mdun bskyed kyi steng gi nam mkha' sogs gong ltar dang*/ bcom ldan tshe dpag med mgon yang*// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byon nas kyang*// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal brgya'i bar du srings// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ a mā ra ṇi sogs sbyar/

byin rlabs skabs/ zhes gsol ba btab pas mdun bskyed kyi tshe dpag tu med pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig dang*/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe chad nyams yar ba thams cad dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud/ 'khor 'das kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan thams cad 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas sku tshe'i bar du gcod pa thams cad byang zhing dag sogs cho ga bsgrigs dkyus ltar sbyar/ sku rten tshe dpag med kyi sku lta bu phul na legs/ yon tan gyi rten mdun bskyed kyi tshe bum dang*/ tshe ril/ tshe chang bcas 'bul/ sna bdun byin rlabs skabs a mā ra ṇi'i sngags kyis bya ba sogs khyad par kha bsgyur phra mo rnams ma 'khrul bar sbyar/ des mtshon te tshe rta zung 'brel lta bu la sbyar na'ang gong gi rigs bsgre zhing*/ gsol 'debs skabs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥsnang ba mtha' yas sogs brjod pa kho nas 'thus pa sogs rgya cher spros te shes par bya'o// 'gro la phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi gcig pu// bstan 'dzin che rnams dbang bcu'i ye shes mchog /grub pa'i cho ga 'di bgyis legs byas kyis// srid zhi'i phun tshogs dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /ces pa'ang rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ rmor chen rin po che/ zhu chen ma hā paṇḍi ta sogs tshad mar gyur pa'i gzhung las legs par btus te don la rang bzo'i dri ma med par nyams su blang bde ba'i nyung ngu rnam gsal bklags pas grub par bstar ba 'di'ang*/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba'i dge bas bstan 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtshor brtan cing chos kyi 'khor lo dus rtag tu bskor ba dang*/ 'jig rten kun tu bde skyed chos mthun gyi 'byor pas khyab cing rtag pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

//sarba ka lyā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
